tools.description: Runs the nightly order export script for a date range, then moves the generated CSV file into the archive folder for that month. Returns the final archived file path.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First order date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last order date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: store_code
params.description: Short code of the storefront whose orders are exported, e.g. 'us-main'.

tools.name: grant_agent_order_access
tools.description: Looks up an order and gives a support agent access to it with the requested permission level (view or edit). Returns the order summary along with the granted access.

params.name: agent_email
params.description: Email address of the support agent receiving access.

tools.name: send_guest_tracking_link
tools.description: Creates a guest tracking token that lets anyone with the link view an order's status, and emails that link to the given address.

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address that should receive the tracking link.

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool

from shop.auth import token_store


@dataclass
class TrackingLinkResult:
    order_id: str
    url: str
    sent_to: str


@tool
def send_guest_tracking_link(order_id: str, recipient_email: str) -> dict:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    token_store.grant(token=token, order_id=order_id, scope="order:track", ttl_days=30)
    url = f"https://shop.example.com/track/{order_id}?t={token}"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"], msg["To"], msg["Subject"] = "orders@shop.example.com", recipient_email, f"Track order {order_id}"
    msg.set_content(f"You can follow your order here: {url}")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.shop.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return TrackingLinkResult(order_id, url, recipient_email).__dict__
